# Vendored dependencies

This directory retains small, redistributable release artifacts used by the
repository's independent test oracles, plus reviewed production data assets.
Tool archives remain test-only. Production assets are imported into pure Roc
package data at compile time and never loaded through a native or runtime file
dependency.

CI consumes the checked-in bytes directly and never downloads a replacement
when an artifact is missing or has the wrong digest. Every binary is covered
by `assets/provenance.json`, including its exact byte length, SHA-256 digest,
immutable origin, license, attribution, and redistribution decision. The
repository contract checker hashes every tracked binary before Roc allocation
measurements begin.

## Package dependencies

The production package depends on two pure-Roc packages, fetched by `roc` from
their immutable release URLs; they are not vendored or bundled. The URL's
final path segment is the bundle's content hash, so a changed archive cannot
satisfy the pin. `package/main.roc` and `package/all.roc` declare both.

| Package | Version | Release bundle | Archive SHA-256 | License | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `roc-lang/unicode` | 4.3.1 | [BNmth7q83JT3Pc2neutkWibVwFwNNNBLhhKfZhmDREeL.tar.zst](https://github.com/roc-lang/unicode/releases/download/4.3.1/BNmth7q83JT3Pc2neutkWibVwFwNNNBLhhKfZhmDREeL.tar.zst) | `119846d77be7e87cff22396219a8d060833c4ee2c3b7e54ba94dc2fb7a37d168` | UPL-1.0 | Scalar, segmentation, bidirectional, and case analysis |
| `lukewilliamboswell/roc-deflate` | 0.4.0-rc4 | [FoGWbhCP9K1Qk7HA9wcSxHYTpiwTHmCpfNUZx7rAGSSk.tar.zst](https://github.com/lukewilliamboswell/roc-deflate/releases/download/0.4.0-rc4/FoGWbhCP9K1Qk7HA9wcSxHYTpiwTHmCpfNUZx7rAGSSk.tar.zst) | `ef6d916b1629440ef0dab40e8416014dac227aeb60c2ecf19f2a28ecddf6d77d` | Apache-2.0 | DEFLATE compression behind `package/KernelDeflate.roc` |

`roc-deflate` 0.4.0-rc4 (fork commit `78e74dd`) is a fork of
`niclas-ahden/roc-deflate` carrying Richard Feldman's pure-Roc port of
libdeflate (upstream `rtfeldman/roc-deflate@1b39584`), which is
byte-identical to libdeflate at levels 0 to 12. rc2's compressed output is
byte-identical to rc1's; it sizes the level 10 to 12 matchfinder buffers
to the input instead of libdeflate's fixed maximum, and works around
roc-lang/roc#11933 and roc-lang/roc#11934. rc3 builds on Roc
nightly-2026-10-18 without warnings, and rc4 reuses its tables across blocks
(level 10 allocates 30 times per stream instead of 114). Both are
byte-identical to rc2's output at every level. The package calls it from
exactly one place, `KernelDeflate.compress_raw`, at the fixed level
`KernelDeflate.level`.

Upgrade policy: move to an upstream `niclas-ahden/roc-deflate` release as soon
as one includes the libdeflate port, and treat any version or level change as
a byte-contract change: every snapshot, gallery PDF, and allocation baseline is
regenerated and reviewed, and `development/performance/output-size.md` records the
size and work movement.

## Retained artifacts

Current retained tools are:

- Apache PDFBox 3.0.8's standalone application JAR;
- qpdf 12.3.2's Linux x86-64 binary archive; and
- PDFium Chromium 7988's Linux x64 archive.

Retained font inputs include:

- The ten unchanged roc-font rc4 static faces described below, used by the
  ordinary facade's built-in family/style choices;
- Inter 4.1 Regular, retained byte-for-byte from its official release archive
  under OFL-1.1 as the original regression-fixture source; and
- `Roc PDF Sans Regular`, a renamed deterministic regression subset generated by
  `scripts/build_builtin_font.py` with fontTools 4.61.1. Its exact Unicode
  selection and transformation procedure are reviewable in that script. The
  modified font does not use Inter's Reserved Font Name. The script writes it to
  `package/RocPdfSans-Regular.ttf`, where the private
  `package/KernelBuiltInFont.roc` module byte-imports it for retained private
  regression fixtures, and records its length and digest in
  `assets/provenance.json`. The ordinary facade selects the rc4 assets instead.
  Compiler-checked expects still pull the regression fixture into the bundle;
  the bundle consumer verifies that exact dependency closure and Roc's
  unchanged default 10 MiB package limit.

Current retained production color inputs are:

- `package/sRGB2014.icc`, the International Color Consortium's official sRGB
  v2 profile, retained byte-for-byte under the ICC's unrestricted
  copy/distribute/embed license. `scripts/build_srgb_profile.py` verifies it
  and emits the private `package/KernelSrgbProfile.roc` module, which
  byte-imports it, so the packaged sRGB profile is compiled package data rather
  than a runtime file dependency. Its retrieval and verification chain is recorded in
  `vendor/icc/NOTICE.md`.

Gallery examples keep the fonts they use beside their app roots, in
`examples/<name>/fonts/`, so an example directory is self-contained for a
bundle consumer. Each file is an unmodified static TTF (only the styles the
example uses) copied byte-for-byte from the official release archive below,
under OFL-1.1, with the upstream license text beside it. Because the files
are unmodified, the Reserved Font Names of the Source families do not
restrict them. Each archive was downloaded twice over HTTPS and both copies
had the SHA-256 digest listed; `assets/provenance.json` records every font
file's own length and digest.

Earlier selections were narrowed by two package limits that are now lifted:
the font validator rejected odd-length Macintosh-platform `name` records
(IBM Plex, JetBrains Mono, Noto Sans Italic 2.015;
`development/performance/font-inspection.md`), and the subsetter required the
`cvt `, `fpgm`, `gasp`, and `prep` hinting tables (Fraunces 1.000, the Source
Serif 4 desktop TTFs, unhinted Noto; `development/performance/font-subsetting.md`).

Keep upstream tool archives and source font files byte-for-byte intact. To update one, review its license
and bundled notices, download the exact immutable release, verify the upstream
digest, replace the artifact and attribution together, update the provenance
record and CI reference, run `./scripts/test.py`, and commit the whole upgrade
atomically. Do not use Git LFS or add a download fallback.

Whole Roc/Zig toolchains, JDK distributions, and container images are too
large and platform-specific for Git. Hermetic deployments should preload those
exactly pinned dependencies into an immutable runner image.

The packaged defaults retain roc-font 0.1.0-rc4's ten unchanged upstream static
faces: Inter and Merriweather Regular/Bold/Italic/Bold Italic and Fira Code
Regular/Bold. Exact release, upstream archive, member, face and licence pins
are in `vendor/fonts/roc-font/upstream-pins.json`. All ten faces and three OFL
notices ship in `package/fonts/`; Merriweather retains its Reserved Font Name
because its files are unchanged. `scripts/build_roc_font_instances.py --check`
verifies them offline. Pass `--bundle PATH` to additionally verify every member
against the digest-pinned published bundle; `--install --bundle PATH` reproduces
the files without fontTools or modification.

The rc3 variable inputs, pins and instancing recipe remain under
`vendor/fonts/roc-font/` as historical evidence. They are not production assets
and do not enter the package bundle. See [the integration record](../development/roc-font.md).
